description.text: Starter Set Terastal Mewtwo ex, released on 22 September 2023 with Skeledirge ex's: a ready-to-play 60-card deck with two copies of Mewtwo ex in its Lightning Tera form, which takes no attack damage while on the Bench. One of its attacks attaches up to two basic Psychic Energy from the discard pile to your Pokémon, and the other does 30 more damage for each Psychic Energy on your Pokémon. The box held damage counters, Poison and Burn markers, a coin, a paper playmat and a guide.
